warning_texts: The machine rule caveats_declared matches caveat topics by substring, so a caveat that keeps the required phrase and then negates it passes; the inverted CLM-COMPLETION-PARTNER caveat is exactly that case and only this auditor's reading caught it.

The stage prompt says quarantine/ is not an input of this step, but the runner handoff input_globs include quarantine/**/*; I recomputed from quarantine/orders.csv (comment column removed per quarantine/manifest.json) and did not open raw_data/ or clean_data/.

The stage prompt expects independent_claim_recalc.json to be rooted in clean_data/, but it lists raw_data/orders.csv as the source for all six claims, consistent with check_plan claims_recomputed reading raw_latest; it is not rooted in analysis/ or release/, so this is not a self-check and not a fin

audit/prompts/COMMON_CONTRACT.md and audit/human_decisions.yaml are not in this step's allowed input paths; I used the common contract text embedded in the stage prompt and did not read human_decisions.yaml.

Commands run: python audit/results/gate_claims_auditor/evidence/recompute_claims.py (read quarantine/orders.csv, metrics/calculated_metrics.json, analysis/claim_register.json, analysis/answers/*.json, audit/analysis_plan.json, gate_claims_machine evidence/checks.json; wrote evidence/recompute_output

Student t quantiles were computed with a fourth-order Cornish-Fisher expansion because scipy could not be probed; at df above 12000 its error is far below the 0.01 EUR tolerance, and the resulting bounds match the gate to 1e-7.
Deduplication by file order (last row wins) and by latest updated_at give the identical 44531-order population, so the dedup rule is not sensitive to which reading of latest_revision_wins is used.

No deterministic rule checks the R03 and R04 test statistics, effect sizes or the R05 note; I recomputed the z statistic, Welch t and Cohen's d and they match, and R05 names shipping_total with no claim, so this unchecked surface is small enough for the stage to carry.

The CLM-COMPLETION-* caveats do not say in words that cancelled and pending orders are in the denominator; the population and n (24597 = 17818 delivered + 3322 cancelled + 3457 pending; 19934 = 12055 + 3845 + 4034) show they are, and no caveat topic requires it, so this is a note, not a blocker.
summary: All six claims, their intervals, n, level and method reproduce exactly from the quarantine projection (44531 orders after last-revision dedup and 10 negative-refund exclusions) and agree with the metrics registry and every claims_recomputed / recompute_estimate / min_group_size comparison. One blocker: the sampling-interval caveat on CLM-COMPLETION-PARTNER has been inverted and now asserts that the interval covers a changing country mix, which the spec forbids; caveats_declared passed it because it matches the topic by substring only.
